spec2def(wined3dcfg.cpl wined3dcfg.spec)

# wined3dcfg.cpl is all Rust (wined3dcfg-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/wined3dcfg-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# wined3dcfg.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wined3dcfg-rust/src/wined3dcfg/wined3dcfg.rs)
# general.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/wined3dcfg-rust/src/wined3dcfg/general.rs)
add_cargo_module(wined3dcfg wined3dcfg-cargo wined3dcfg.cpl
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE wined3dcfg-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
